caption: The drawing features three representations of a shoe on a plain, light beige background. The primary object, located in the lower right quadrant, is a detailed colored illustration of a heeled shoe that appears to be a light tan or off-white color, with a pointed toe, low upper, and fitted heel that is a slightly darker brown on the bottom edge. Above and to the left of the main shoe are two line drawings showing the shoe from a top-down perspective; the left shoe outline includes some extra detail indicating the upper design of the shoe, while the right outline is a simpler, more minimal depiction. The overall composition is sparse, with all elements grouped on the right half of the page and ample empty space surrounding them.
title: Slippers
